description: the rigid fish of cfd_2d_6dof_fish 10 % heavier than water, accelerated in x by gravity (W 20 0.5), surge only, with the fluid-momentum coupling (X 198) and the low-storage RK3 of the bodies: the load of the body beyond the fluid (M - rho_f V) g with gamma + zeta of each stage (before: gamma alone, 1.68 times the load over the step) and the momentum of the fluid gained in the stage with the ratio of the masses. After 1 s the velocity agrees with the SSP-RK3 stages and with X 197 to 2 % (Fish Swimming validation 06).
covers: sixdof_obj_cfd::momentum_loads, low-storage RK3 with rho_b > rho_f
